theme_and_archetype.description: A trustworthy, calming interface combining healthcare/IVF empathy with high-efficiency SaaS functionality. Uses a 3-pane WhatsApp-style layout adapted for desktop.

layout_and_spacing.global_strategy: The app fits into a desktop viewport. Assuming the main app sidebar is on the far left, this workspace occupies the remaining width and height. It uses a 3-pane responsive-flex or CSS grid architecture: [Chat List (350px)] [Main Chat (flex-1)] [Context Panel (300px)].
layout_and_spacing.chat_list_pane: Fixed width 350px, border-r border-slate-200, bg-white, h-full flex flex-col.
layout_and_spacing.chat_main_pane: Flex-1, bg-chat-pane bg-[#F0F2F5] h-full flex flex-col relative.
layout_and_spacing.context_pane: Fixed width 300px, border-l border-slate-200, bg-white, h-full flex flex-col overflow-y-auto.

components.name: ChatWorkspaceContainer
components.description: Main wrapper. h-screen (or h-full of parent), w-full, flex row. Fits into the existing CRM layout.

components.name: ConversationListPane
components.description: Left pane. Header with search. Category filter tabs (All / Unread / Interested Customer) using custom buttons or Shadcn Tabs. Scrollable list of chat row items.
components.interaction: Clicking a row selects the active chat. Rows with unread messages are bold and have a WhatsApp Green (#25D366) badge.

components.name: ChatThreadPane
components.description: Center pane. Includes a Header (Avatar, Name, Status, Starred Messages Toggle). Pinned Messages bar below header. Message list with scrollable area. WhatsApp-style bubbles.
components.rules: Customer messages on left (white bg), Agent messages on right (#DCF8C6 bg). Include Date separators (e.g., 'Today'). Message bubbles show timestamp and status ticks (Sent/Delivered/Read).

components.name: MessageBubble
components.description: Individual message bubble. Rounded corners, dropping the corner on the side of the sender (WhatsApp style).
components.hover_actions: On hovering a message bubble, reveal actions: React (emoji), Reply (quote), Star, Pin. Smooth fade-in.

components.name: ComposerBar
components.description: Bottom of chat pane. Attach button (Paperclip), Emoji button (Smiley), text input (rounded-full bg-white, grows on multi-line), Send button (PaperPlaneTilt).

components.name: ContextPanel
components.description: Right pane. Avatar, Lead Name, Phone, Email. Big CTA button 'Move to Interested Customer' using Brand Primary (#8B5CF6). Quick info list.
components.interaction: Can be toggled via header button in ChatThreadPane.

components.name: GlobalNotificationToast
components.description: Floating WhatsApp-style notification toast. Appears globally when new inbound message arrives.

icon_strategy.usage: Use Phosphor icons with 'weight' set to 'regular' or 'fill' depending on active state. Install via: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react. Key icons: Checks (for read receipts), Paperclip, PaperPlaneTilt, MagnifyingGlass, Star, PushPin, Smiley.

rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Use kebab-case and role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='chat-row-user-1', data-testid='message-input', data-testid='send-button', data-testid='tab-unread').
Contrast ratio must exceed 4.5:1. Ensure text over WhatsApp green is dark/legible.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create the 3-pane layout assuming it sits to the right of an existing app sidebar.
Use React + Tailwind CSS + Shadcn UI primitives. Write components using .js or .jsx extensions, NOT .tsx.
Implement Phosphor icons (@phosphor-icons/react) as the primary icon set.
Use Sonner for the global new message toast.
Ensure all components map to the 'data-testid' requirement.
Use the provided image URLs for contact avatars in the conversation list.
Implement the specific message bubble colors (#DCF8C6 for right/agent, #FFFFFF for left/customer) and the specific ticks for Sent/Delivered/Read.
